body: A wound around self-worth and security: a deep sense of not having or deserving enough, whatever you actually hold.
business: You become unusually good at helping others build real stability and value themselves.
shadow: Over-accumulating or self-denying to prove you are safe.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
